package.name: i2rt_can_driver
package.description: Pure C++ SocketCAN driver for I2RT DM-series motors (YAM arm). Ports i2rt/motor_drivers/{can_interface.py,utils.py,dm_driver.py} with no ROS dependency, so it can be built, tested, and used standalone. Consumed by i2rt_hardware_interface as the ros2_control plugin's backing library.
